  identity         gpg key 6732361300BBFDAE7F22972CD4381E1CE2880244 (sign)
                   THE SANDBOX CAN SIGN AS YOU with this OpenPGP key —
                   commits, tags, release artifacts, mail — for as long as the
                   run lasts. snug generates commit.gpgsign = true, so commits
                   inside are signed by default. No private key enters the
                   sandbox and your other keys cannot be listed or used.
                   gpg key 6732361300BBFDAE7F22972CD4381E1CE2880244 (decrypt)
                   THE SANDBOX CAN DECRYPT ANYTHING ADDRESSED TO THIS KEY that
                   it can read, for as long as the run lasts. The proxy sees an
                   opaque ciphertext and cannot tell which message it is
                   decrypting.
